title: Book One · Chapter 182: A Bell Again
story:
Dad puts the blue bike in the yard.

Ronan brings the bell. Mum brings an old cloth.

“The mud can stay outside,” she says.

Dad agrees. He has enough space to work by the wall. He puts his tools near the wall. People can walk past them safely.

Ronan sits nearby.

He wants to do everything himself. He also wants the bike to be safe.

“What can I do?”

Dad gives him the cloth.

“Start with the seat and the bars.”

Ronan wipes them carefully. Blue comes through the grey dust. The long scratch stays.

He wipes it again.

“That one is in the paint,” Dad says.

“I know.”

But Ronan tries one more time before he leaves it alone.

Dad checks the brake. He gets a new brake pad. They kept some money for this part. Now they use that money.

It takes longer than Ronan wants.

He walks to the gate, comes back, then sits down again.

“Can I try now?”

“Not yet.”

Ronan looks at Dad’s hands. The little cut from moving day is long gone. There are other marks now, small lines from other jobs.

The blue box is still the same blue box.

One corner is darker. Ronan remembers carrying his little paper box beside it.

“You kept this,” he says.

Dad follows his eyes.

“It is still useful.”

“It is very heavy.”

“You are stronger now.”

Ronan lifts one side a little. He could not do that before. The box is still heavy, so he puts it down with both hands.

When the brake is ready, Dad checks it again. He moves the bike, stops it, and asks Mum to look with him.

Then he turns to the bell.

“Does this fit? Let’s see.”

Ronan has waited for these words.

He hands it over. Dad tries its old place on the handlebar. He adjusts it, checks it, then asks Ronan to sit on the bike.

“Can you reach?”

Ronan puts his hand on the bar. His thumb finds the little lever.

Ring.

The cat lifts its head.

Ring.

The cat gets up and moves to the other side of the yard.

“It remembers,” Mum says.

Ronan laughs.

Dad gives him room to stand with the bike. They check the seat once more. Then they choose a quiet place to practise. An adult will stay beside him.

There will be time to go farther later.

Mum puts the old cloth in the small box in the kitchen. It is not the only cloth in there now.

Ronan runs a finger round the bell.

“Does it look strange on a blue bike?”

Dad looks carefully.

“It looks like your bell on your bike.”

Ronan presses it once more.

The sound goes through the green gate and into the street.

He remembers the red bike. A man took it away. Ronan kept the bell in his pocket that day. He had a bell that day, but no bicycle. He could ring it, but he could not ride home.

Now the bell is on a handlebar again. They chose this blue bike together.

Dad closes the tool box. Ronan helps him clear the ground.

“Next Sunday?” Ronan asks.

“Next Sunday, after breakfast. We can try a little in the yard before then.”

“Is that a promise?”

Dad looks at him.

“Yes. That one is a promise.”

Ronan nods. He does not ring the bell again that evening. Twice he goes outside to look at the bike, then comes back to the room.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达
- wipe：擦拭。
- adjust：调整。
- reach：够得着。
- lever：拨杆。

## 理解
1. 为什么要等检查完成后再骑车？
2. 蓝色工具箱和车铃分别怎样连接过去与现在？
